My review is coming from a lady from California. The service and food was excellent! The scallops with a cream corn and a green salsa was to die for. Heirloom tomatoes  was excellent. My husband had the half chicken he said was "ok" I recommend it.

If the kitchen closes before the restaurant, you should make note of that - anywhere!! I just went there at 11:20 and the host told me that the kitchen was closed and they were only serving drinks. Update your hours so people aren't wasting there time and traveling far to come to a restaurant when the kitchen isn't even open!!

Perfect Burger, and amazing dessert! 
Relax atmosphere, comfort food, this will be my go-to place in mid town from now on!

Great brunch spot right near the Time Warner Center. At a table or the bar - great entree options with a little touch of unusual - such as curried tomato with scrambled eggs or homemade granola. Nice selection of breakfast drinks and good service as well :-)

Cute hotel bar. I met my friends here on Saturday evening for a dinner. We were seating at the bar. Bartender Imani was very kind and professional. Since no of us was eating she gave great recommendation on desserts. I had chocolate peanut butter baked Alaska and it was amazing!!!!! My friend had pumpkin pudding kind of dessert ( not sure what was the name).
Really enjoyed the place. We will definitely go back

James became one of my favorite restaurant in NYC. I went the other night and I didn't know what to choose since it was my first time . The waitress Dora was so adorable , she came to attend the table and help us with food  aswell. She was very professional and had so much knowledge about food and wines. I had gnocchi and scallops and I drank Cabernet. Desserts were delicious. The prices were affordable.I loved the vibe and the interior design. I will definitely come back . Thank you Dora for making our night even better .
AMAZING. The kale salad is to die for. The restaurant is so cool. Great for drinks, dinner, girls night, family night, or a date night!

High end place with great food selection! Very nice atmosphere, great level of service! Gnochi was my favorite dish, can't wait to come back and have it again. I also want to give a great thank you to our server Dora. She was very nice and attentive to the table. I surely will come back again hence this place is amazing.

I'm actually pretty shocked by some of these reviews. We recently stayed for a long weekend at 1Hotel Central Park and were too tired the first night to go anywhere so we ordered in from Jams. The chicken and potatoes were very good, and one order of each was plenty for my husband and I to share. The next day we also ordered up for brunch and let me tell you - this is the real star of the show. It was SO good I want to drive back to Manhattan for more. I got the French toast with a side of bacon and it was the best I've ever had. It came with wonderful homemade whipped cream, jam, and yummy warm syrup. My husband got the fried chicken sandwich with waffle fries and was equally as happy. The only problem here is that we both wanted to eat each other's meal but also eat our own too. Ughh those were also the best waffle fries I've ever had. The next morning we ordered the assortment of pastries and everything was equally as delicious. I would've thought they came from a full fledged bakery, not just a restaurant with a bakery in it.I am also impressed by how quick we got our food each time!! Everything was so delicious and I love how eco-friendly it is. The food wasn't outrageous priced either.

I wish I could rate this place higher, because the food was pretty good, but the service was absolutely awful. Our waiter disappeared halfway through our meal and it took forever to get our check. I got the French toast and it was really tasty. They have plenty of other good options as well and the environment is really cute. But gotta improve the service please.

My wife and I really enjoyed our brunch visit here. What a calming break from the hustle of the city. 

Decor was done really well, a very calming feel while there. Service was also excellent, we wanted for nothing. 

Wife had the chicken sandwich and I had the roast chicken. Both were excellent. While the roast chicken wasn't a new taste experience, it was executed perfectly and in that, it was became exceptional. 

The chicken sandwich was slo really great. Hard to describe the nuanced difference execution makes for something so common as a chicken sandwich, but it makes a difference. 

I'll be back in NY in another month and I can't wait to come back and have it all again.
Great latte and breakfast Jams! Steel cut oatmeal and their famous Jams omelet. Attached to 1Hotel, a very hip spot to stay while in town. Pricy, but it's midtown so what else is new?  :-)
Service was bad. Cocktails are excellent. Food good but wasn't hot. I would come back but sit at the bar .

Food is ok. Ambiance is great. Watch out if you use women's restroom by the kitchen. Locks counterclockwise and the staff opens the door on you if not locked. It happened to me and my friend in a matter of 10mins.

I can only really base this review off of my drink and dessert, because that is all I ordered. I ordered the "autumn breeze" cocktail and it was amazing! All of the flavors paired so well together, it tasty "cozy" like fall but also very refreshing from the apple flavors. We ordered the "baked Alaska" for dessert. It said it had a mint ice cream in the inside and fudge. There was sort of an orange ice cream that tasted okay but strange to eat since it was so orange in color. I was disappointed to find no fudge but rather a chocolate type cookie. We ordered the dessert to share but it was about the size of my palm. I will end on a positive note though, the atmosphere and decor was beautiful. It was a great place to meet up with a friend for a drink, it felt like you were out of the city and in a beautiful Forrest. I would definitely go back.

Patricia- what a bartender!   Talked me up during Christmas Day while making so many cocktails.  

And get this! I'm pretty serious about my Manhattan and both mine were made from a master, stirred and the right amount of bitters. 

It's raw to find well made cocktails and the woman's confidence rocked my world on my visit.

Such a WONDERFUL place. The atmosphere is really nice the seats are comfortable and spacious and yet does not feel Like there is a bunch of people. Now onto the food. The charcuterie plate was amazing. SOOOO GOOD. Then the sides - cauliflower and squash soup and meatballs were all also DELICIOUS. I recommend sharing a few and then DRUMROLL PLEASE the gnocchi.

THE GNOCCHI!!!!!!
To die for.
That's all.
Get it.
And the drinks are good and creative too.
I went to Jams as usual had a great time , great service,  fun atmosphere and  clean. I recommend jams if you're coming to watch a ballgame listen some good music have a good drink and a good time.
Hands down the best roasted chicken I've ever had. Perfectly roasted with a crispy/flavorful skin but juicy inside. Paired with broccolini.

This spot is located inside the 1 Hotel Central Park. It had a nice amount of seating, although not huge space. 

We started off with some drinks. I chose Grapes of Wrath. The interesting thing was that they had some sugar on the outside rims, but only about half of less than half the glass rim was coated... Did they forget to do the other side, or they realized after half way that they were not supposed to do that???  My hubby went with Apple Crusta. It was more lemony than apple, which was a bit confusing... 

We ordered Maplebrook Burrata and Salt Cod Brandade to share as appetizers, and they were both really great! We all enjoyed it a whole lot.  

For main, I had Coconut-Curry Seafood Stew. It was delicious, spicy and full of jewels of the sea! The others went with Berkshire Pork Chop, and Pan Roasted Atlantic Hake. I heard it was the best pork chop she ever had, and the hake was a big hit too. We also had one side dish to share: Fried Fingerling Potatoes. Sooo good, it disappeared quickly!  

Since we all enjoyed the food massively, we decided to push our luck with desserts. We had Cranberry-Almond Tart, Ginger Sticky Toffee Pudding, and Chocolate-Peanut Butter Baked Alaska. They were all really good, but the tart was the crowd's favorite. 

The bathrooms were not in a great shape. I heard one of them were not tidy (toilet paper all over on the floor), and another one, the toilet was not flushing. I went into the one with the broken toilet, and since I am a proud handy-woman, I fixed it for them before I used it. Seems like several people had used the toilet before I came along, so I wonder when any of their staffs went to check the cleanliness of the bathroom... The rest of the space and the food was amazing, so it is very disappointing to see that they are not putting enough care to their bathroom... 

Other than that, the service was great. Our water glass was always filled, and we were well taken care of. I would love to go back and try more of their amazing dishes!

Looks very pretty when you entered with a cost feelIng. I was here for brunch which means their menu is different from the usual dinner. I was not impressed with brunch. On the contrary it was quite disappointing. I ordered their bagel with cream cheese. The cream cheese was served and a side  in a small container. You could tell it was used and old as the cheese was not leveled and had created that layer of old on top.  - disgusting. I ordered a aide of scramble eggs. It was served in a flat plate and it was ok but nothIng to rave. I make more appetizing scramble eggs. We ordered tea after our meal, arrived  so late as we were already paying. The server seems off, maybe tired but not very attentive. Kept giving me what my friend has clearly ordered and  looked at me rather at her at all times.

Located in the 1 Hotel right next to central park. Was initially drawn in because of the beautiful ivy all along the wall on the outside. Service was a bit slow and the food was okay. The poke I ordered was beautiful but hardly anything in it. I'm a small person who can get by with ordering smaller plates but I'm not kidding you when I say this had 3 bites in it. The charcuterie board was also just subpar. Overpriced for amount of food that was given. Bellinis were delicious though!!

We had the charcuterie, poke and kale salad. The food was great for lunch. Kale salad was perfectly seasoned. I love a great charcuterie so that was awesome!
The bartender was a bit lacking in eye contact, and when she brought our drinks she just placed it where I had to reach for it. Showed that she really didn't care; yet, the guy  seated next to us received better service.

Hats off to the chef but service needs improvement.

I came here for breakfast with coworkers and it just didn't impress me. The restaurant is gorgeous and the service is good but the food itself left me wanting more, especially for the price. I had the breakfast platter and the food was bland. I wish the portion was also a bit more due to the cost. Not much else to say, probably won't be back in a long time due to the other options in the area.

I came in last night for the first time and had an amazing time! Doruntina was my server and she was a superstar! She made great recommendations and was very attentive. I started with a kale salad and then had the duck and pork chop! I would definitely come back!

This place is sooo good. I loved everything I ate. This is my second time here and it was just as great as the first. We've got to try a few things on the menu and every single thing was amazing. Bruce was our waiter and he was so helpful and attentive. We also got to meet Chef Kali and she was awesome too. She was extremely knowledgeable on all of the plates and ingredients.  The duck was delicious and so was the steak. The kale salad is my absolute favor and the venison meatballs were also very good. I also love the vibe of this place. Our table was constantly cleaned and our drinks were always filled.  I would highly recommend this restaurant!!

I just wanted to give my best impressions to this great place and its great service. I ate apple salad and strip steak and it was wonderful. It had great taste and flavor to it. What made my experience even better at Jams is my server Dora. She was an amazing and hardworking young woman who really took care of us and gave us the best service BY FAR. Thank you very much for that great experience. Will definitely come back.

Ask for Marcy she is the best waitress I have had in NYC
Order mr beat 
Drinks were great

Awesome place for brunch. We took a look inside and gave it a shot. Great decor, very serene, staff looked like they were in a good mood. This was our first time in the restaurant, we were in the mood for sandwiches, my friend ordered the French toast, amazing , and I was torn between the chicken sandwich and the burger, Richard made my decision very easy, he knew how to describe his dishes. Most servers on other restaurant will basically choose one recommended dish but our server took his time and gave us his take on both items, not putting one down. Long story short , the chicken sandwich was the best sandwich I've tasted in a long time. The food was amazing, service was on point and we will definitely rave about this place . Thank you Jams !!!

We were looking for something near the theatre district that wasn't typical theatre district pub food. This place is a fantastic decision for pre show. The service was exceptional without being pushy. Our server was Bruce and he was beyond great. We had real conversations with him, not stuffy server banter. He was so knowledgeable about the menu recommending the meatballs which at first seem like an unconventional choice because they're venison, but they were one of the best dishes on the table. Bruce made sure my glass of champagne was always full and the other diners had everything they needed He advised us through our choices and we're glad he did. Chris, the manager, came over and again spoke to us like we had been friends for years. Jams is incredible, so welcoming, unpretentious, with food and drink that are out of this world. 10 out of 10 would recommend!

UNBELIEVABLY GOOD FOOD & IMPECCABLE SERVICE. Chris Vega, the GM, so kind and gracious, came out and talked to us and made suggestions (which were all incredible, esp venison meatballs and the pork chop was tantamount to honeymoon sex). Our server, Bruce, was so present and easy going and the perfect compliment to a perfect experience. Like a shamanic guide on a transcendental hike through food paradise. We were going to a broadway show at 8 and he timed everything flawlessly. We wanted a restaurant midtown but nothing there is good. If you're going for a show or want to eat and talk with friends for hours in a comfortable, stylish spot with orgasmic food - this is your place. So glad I found it! Huge fan going back a lot now.
Jonathan Waxman is master Yoda when it comes to fried chicken!  His chicken sandwich is still the best in the land!  It comes with a heavy price tag at $25 bonez, but still well worth it!

I am a regular at Jams for their coffee and just came by today during the NYC shutdown.  In typical fashion they are the most welcoming and hospitable place in NYC.  In particular Carley, Amoni, Patricia, and Jon (who recently left), among the entire rest of the cast, not only make you feel like you're family, they also make sure your are served the highest quality food and drink.  Just as a shout out the service doesn't stop at the restaurant walls - if you happen to come in via 58th street, the team manning the door, greet you like you're one of their old friends.  What a great place!

My experience last night has left me in bed with a trash can next to me due to food poisoning. A friend and I went for a drink and a bite to catch up. The hotel was in great condition, as always, and the staff was extremely friendly and welcoming. I ordered a veggie sandwich and a mezcal margarita. My drink has not just one, but two bugs in it, I mentioned that it was a odd that a drink would have 2 bugs, that they should look at their ingredients. They apologized and offer to make a new one. As I was waiting they pointed out that their mezcal had bugs... A few minutes later I had a bug-free drink. We had a lovely time and the sandwich was tasty. This morning I woke up with food poisoning that appears to have been cause by either the alfalfa or the egg on the sandwich. I doubt their to-go sandwiches are prepared daily with fresh ingredients. If you are going to have a reduced menu, you must be certain that you are providing fresh uncontaminated ingredients. I would have never expected this from a One hotel.

So, I walk in and go straight to the counter.  I order a 'hero' and a drink. A moment later, she hands me a pre-made $16 hero, and a minute later she pours my $14 drink and leaves it at the counter. No table service. Nothing. 

The 'hero?' Well, let's just say if I were to use an emoji to describe it, it would not be the infamous eggplant. It would be, well, more a jalapeno. The smallest $14 sandwich I ever ordered in my life. 

The drink, I have to say, was solid. A rich Bloody Mary, well-seasoned with more than enough olives. 

But when I check the receipt I realize that it's $10 more than it should be -- they automatically add a 20% tip! A 20% tip for a woman who never left the counter before I got my order and after I got my order. 

How should I say this, um, eff that. I'll decide what tip, if any, a counter lady deserves for an order from a single patron

I will never go to that place again and, well, the six to eight buddies that I see at my local watering hole tonight won't either after I regale them with my experience there today.

Came here for brunch with a couple friends. This has a great location right near the park and the interior is bright and welcoming. We ordered a few of the cocktails right off the bat. They were very nice to make us an espresso martini and bloody mary even though these weren't listed on their menus. One downside is it became very challenging for us to get our waitress' attention after the initial order.

For the food, we split the pancakes and I tried the fried chicken sandwich. The pancakes were rather plain without much presentation but tasted pretty good. I did really enjoy the fried chicken sandwich which had very juicy chicken. 

Overall, I enjoyed the ambience and it made fo ra fun brunch place. The service could have been improved but I'm overall satisfied.

Went to Jams on a Saturday afternoon (around 3pm). This was my second time here and the place was full and lively. 

Our server was very sweet and attentive. When asking about items on the menu or drinks she described everything as "oh that's really good." Lol. Super cute. 

I got the Jams breakfast sandwich. It was delicious! And the crispy home fries that came with it were the best! Super crispy on the outside while the inside was still fluffy. The sandwich was on a pretzel roll with scrambled eggs and ham. I recommend it! 

The drinks were great too! I started with the Bloody Mary which was refreshing and balanced perfectly. Then I got the a cocktail from the menu called
The greenhouse. It basically makes you feel healthy because it was green juice with vodka. Lol. 

I recommend making reservations during peak hours for sure!
Very cute brunch area! Has a very nice outside seating area with lots of plants. Service is super good and the food is very good. Love this place.

So good!! This is the cutest restaurant close to Central Park. The food was great and the service was awesome. Felt we had a really nice dinner out without a crazy expensive bill at the end. Would definitely recommend!
Can't speak to the food, but giving this place five stars for the cocktails and ambiance! The vibe is like Midtown meets Brooklyn, and I'm here for it! Great spot to meet after work!

Jams was such a delightful experience. While the restaurant was not technically open (just the walk-up window), the servers were extremely kind and our food was amazing. The sandwiches were a big hit and the drinks were also fantastic.
Interesting vibe with green plants everywhere. Price seems to be decent as well, worth a visit for sure
The space was beautiful and can hold larger groups. The dishes were nice but a little pricey for the portion. I think the ambience was nice.

Have been working here all week. Pretty quiet  with really fast WiFi. Coffee is pretty good. The food is a little overpriced for what it is. Staff is super friendly overall a great place to work from.

Saturday night 5:15 reservation - only 3 tables occupied inside. The server who took drink and appetizer orders disappears. The drinks come but not appetizers? The second server takes entrée orders which come out almost immediately but no appetizers. We asked for the bread order a second time only to receive reheated day old slices of toast and stale biscuits. We complained about late and stale bread but still charged $11? We had the same experience with coffee & dessert. 3 stale cookies for $12? Try and find a server to get the check was torture.  The server knew we had tickets for a show but disappeared for more than 20 minutes in the middle of dinner service.  Not until we headed to the exit does anyone appear and offer to get the check.  Poor service, stale food, buyer beware.  NYC has many other options Juniors near Schubert Alley makes for a much better experience at a lower price point.

Absolutely phenomenal experience at Jams. From the moment you walk in the ambience takes over your senses. The staff and manager were extremely polite and accommodating. The drinks were out of the world, I had a Negroni and my partner a Manhattan. The quality of food was excellent for the price, not to mention sincerely delightful. I wish I could recreate the kale salad. Cannot wait to come back!

Being a longtime fan of Chef Jonathan Waxman's first restaurant, Barbuto, I simply had to try his second Manhattan spot, Jams, as well.  The place had been open for years before I was finally incentivized to make it a priority, as the Chef was in town and would be cooking classics and new menu items on that specific evening.  I gathered my friends with the promise of a great meal and the potential sighting of JW.  

We were sat at a nice, spacious table next to the bar and ordered some drinks.  The Drunken Monk was essentially an extra herbaceous spritz containing Aperol, Cynar, Green Charteuse, lime, and soda. It was crisp, refreshing, and a perfect complement to a summer meal.  

Speaking of, we began the food portion of our meal with the Artisanal Bread Plate, which sounded a bit fancier than it was.  The carb collection included seeded rolls from Grandaisy Bakery and herbed flatbread crisps, served with a creamy roasted carrot and tahini spread.  While this smear was delicious, the bread was rather bland and unexciting.  For my entree, I selected the Gnocchi with Corn and Tomatoes, the perfect summer-inspired dish.  The pan-seared fluffy dumplings had been tossed with local vegetables and topped with basil and Parmesan.  The dish was tasty, but the gnocchi were a bit charred and overcooked.  One of my dining buddies was not overly impressed with his Sowrdfish special, which contained undercooked, crunch couscous on the side.  However, the rest of our party raved about the Filet Mignon and JW specialty roasted Chicken and Fries.  

While our food experience was a bit mixed, we all agreed that our friendly server was really not at the top of her game.  One of my friends needed to ask her for salt about 3 or 4 times before she finally delivered it.  I know that service has been rough Post-COVID, but I would have expected more from a place of this caliber, and especially when we were able to glimpse Chef Waxman taking a break at the bar right behind us.  

Overall, I thought Jams was fine, but it did not live up to my loving memories of Barbuto.

This place is usually packed, but we got lucky and were able to get seats for 2 for Sunday morning brunch with no wait. The service was friendly, but scarce. However the food definitely made up for it. I got the kale salad and it's now one of my absolute favorites. It's very simple but the lemon and breadcrumbs make it DELISH.  My boyfriend got the chicken sandwich and it was very good. The spicy ranch was unique and added a lot of flavor! I'd definitely recommend this place for brunch. I haven't had their dinner menu, but it looks promising too!

Ordered yogurt and fruit with granola. Nothing special. My guests ordered egg sandwich- cold. 
Ordered latte - never received. Not going back. Very nice decor, that's it.

I had to check out Chef Jonathan Waxman's restaurant! The decor is simple but chic.The host greeted us and we were seated.There was no wait which was great. The waiter was friendly and attentive. We ordered the margarita and grapefruit daiquiri which were potent but tasty. I wanted to ordered the butternut squash soup but they did not have it so I opted for the tomato and chickpea soup and the house made gnocchi.The gnocchi was delicious and the tomato soup as well. Beware the tomato soup has bits of pepper flakes which I did not know about ...let's just say I needed 3 glasses of water to calm my taste buds down! Ofcourse, you guys know I can't leave a place a without. We had the chocolate budino and apple crisp. Dessert was scrumptious! I'll try this place again for brunch. If you are into healthy eating this is def the place!

We had the pleasure of working with Andrea Dabu, Catering Manager, to plan an Engagement brunch for our daughter.  Andrea was attentive and prompt with responding to all of our needs.  She worked with the chef to put together a beautiful buffet, taking into account dietary preferences.  The day of the brunch (10/17/21), Andrea greeted her with her staff to make sure every detail was to our satisfaction.  The venue and brunch buffet were absolutely beautiful!!  The 3 servers responsible for the room were professional and attentive throughout the function.  I could not have been more pleased with our experience.  I highly recommend Jams Catering!

While staying at the hotel, I visited Jams the last morning. For some reason prior to our stay when I tried to reserve a table for the same morning online, it said there were none available. However, on the morning that I went, there was plenty of seating available, so I'm not sure why I was getting that message. I sat at the bar and was greeted by a friendly female server. I had coffee, egg whites, and the salad pictured. The service and atmosphere were good, and the food was overall good. I have two complaints though. For one there were flies in the bar area that was very bothersome and two, while my salad was quite tasty, the shrimp were DIRTY! They should have been cleaned/deveined before serving such a salad.

Went to Jams on Sunday afternoon to get some drinks and something small to eat. I got this one drink with Patron and coffee, forgot its name but it was very unique! 

Our server was nice and helpful. The food was really good but I was a bit disappointed in the salmon bagel. When I looked at the menu it sounded like something very extraordinary but in the end, I got... a bagel with salmon lol 

Overall I had a good experience and since Jams is located literally 2 minutes walking distance from Central Park, I will definitely stop by again in the future.

Charged me 20% take out gratuity without ever telling me. No signs posted. Bartender immediately told me after he asked for my credit card without ever giving me the bill. I feel cheated. $21 later with 3oz sandwich seems like a ripoff. No ethics no business.

I feel compelled to share with others of the horrible experience I had at this place. I see the reviews but this is not the experience others had at the same time I was there this past Saturday.
 The outside of this restaurant is very pretty with its classic New York Brick Facade and Black Iron Window Frames. Inside was decorated with natural wood, fabrics and green plants.
We were looking for a good cup of coffee and a delicious sit down hot breakfast. 
This place was a huge disappointment along with a huge bill.  There were not many people in here which should have been the first sign. 
We ordered at a cashier who unfortunately showed annoyance to two individuals before me. They were put off and left. 
I stayed to order. There were only three options for eggs. 
I learned after that they were all cold, pre-made sandwiches/wraps. I ordered the egg cheese and ham sandwich, a wrap, two coffees. You pay and then get on another line to get your coffee and pick up your food. At this point you can sit down and eat. 
We waited for someone to bring water since the tables were set with glasses and silverware. No one came. I needed to go to the bar to ask for water. No one came so I had to reach over and help myself. There was a lot of staff but they were talking among themselves. 
When I opened the sandwich it happened to be hard boiled eggs mashed  and alfalfa sprouts on two slices of grain bread called the Just say yes.  I am allergic to wheat and couldn't eat the bread  I didn't order this sandwich so I tried to eat just the egg. I couldn't even get a teaspoon of eggs of the bread there was so little egg. I had to throw this sandwich out and go across the street to Starbucks for a warm egg sandwich. 
 I expressed my disappointment the person in charge said she would see if she could speak to management but no offer to change the sandwich or refund was made. 
There were many adult employees around but they were not focused on the paying customers who were present in the place.  They were among themselves. 
I am writing this to help this place change management or service practices or to help clients find a better place to enjoy a real breakfast with warm staff in NY where you are not hungry when you leave or get ripped off. Even if the price was cheaper it is NOT worth it. Maybe this is a tourist trap and I didn't know since I am a NYer.

This was one of the worst experiences I've had in New York and I've been to some crap places. We came in around 430 for drinks, and we told the hostess that. When ordering, the server rolled his eyes and was just short with us. After 40 minutes MAX, random people began clearing our table while we were sitting there, despite it being evident that we were still eating our appetizers (we literally had to tell them to stop.) the restaurant wasn't even full, so I don't get the rush they had. The server was good about one thing, bringing out water, but alas when we got our check he charged us $40 worth of water that we never asked for. Unless you are their "ideal" customer (rich dudes that can spend 400 on appetizers) avoid this place and go any other restaurant that actually cares about their customers.

Great location and space- that's really all they have going for it.

We were there for brunch- Fried Chicken Sandwich and the Brioche French Toast. Portions were pretty small, prices were too high. Neither dishes were too bad or particularly good. 

Service was fine, but wouldn't come back for the food.

Last evening we had the most enjoyable dinner.
Some restaurants hit the right note with music level, lighting and ambience, this is one that does it well. Service was friendly, after a bit of an icy reception.
  The Paloma cocktail is well crafted, and frankly delicious. Food was fantastic and well prepared. Definitely a return visit is in order......

I don't get this place. I really want to give it 2.5 out of frustration. But I'll stick with three. Listen the food is...fine? Staff seems...new? But I get it. Covid! People need staff. So I'll give a learning curve for why things in the reservation notes weren't accounted for. Also , for the staffs general timidness. But where the stars are lost is not the decor and not the speed of service, no it's the food. Mr waxman you place your name on this limited menu and walk away. You leave the execution in the hands of unable cooks. Here we have a problem! If you have a menu limited to about 15 dishes, you better knock each one out of the park! You don't. Cranberry bean soup was an odd flavor profile and broken down in its purée where it tasted like a bowl of refries beans. Chicory salad was the star. Balanced and light. The rigatoni was oily and unremarkable. The steak was fine but without the compound butter wouldn't have done the trick. Everything fried here was fine. The fires are nice and on another note the breakfast potatoes are tasty on the outside, but way too dense. Also the limited breakfast options is a pain. Especially when two of the three sandwiches disappoint. The pretzel egg ham and cheese is unbalanced (too much bread.) and the egg white wrap is meh. Finally, all the bread at this place is noticeably dry. If the make it on premise then they need to look into that. I will tell you we stayed at the hotel attached. They gifted us cookies from jams and they were rocks! Point is, they have potential but need a lot of help.
Great atmosphere. Great staff. Great coffee. Delicious food. Egg White OmeletteChicken Salad

convenient central park south location.  nyc.  and in a nice new hotel so obvious not cheap.  restaurant is a nice open space.  boho natural v comfortable decor.  great service.  food was good.  bloody mary v bland.   will keep it on my radar if in midtown bc it's convenient.

This place. Gorgeous. Smells divine. The signature smell of 1 Hotel. Plants everywhere. Staff is great. Seating is wonderful and comfy. Wine is so good. (I did the house red blend) I ordered  fish tacos. They were good- not great. The concept of cool
Guacamole hot batter dipped cod and crunchy spicy slaw is great but it lacked a little seasoning. Not terrible just not great. There were so many menu items that looked yummy I can't wait to return and try the steak or gnocchi!

We were seated with warning that bar tender was taking last call. Totally fine with that. They said we could do one round. Order two drinks. 3 mins later hostess returned and informed us they ran out of ingredients - no problem, we ordered her recommendation. Waited 20 mins, still no drinks. Two guys walked in from the street and were served right away. We waited another 20 mins, still no drinks. Lights came on. We were ignored. NY is a big place and there are plenty of places to hang out. Give Jams a miss and be treated right.
Horrible service, waited 30 minutes for drinks that never came while everyone around us was served.
veryyy overpriced for what it is & waited so long for a table and even longer for food when it wasn't even that busy

VERY happy we stopped in for brunch. The food was light, fresh, and oh so GOOD!! Loved the ambiance of the restaurant. Comfortable, chic, artsy, lots of vibes. The calamari was delightful. The gnocchi had a pesto sauce and was so darn good!!! Would definitely order again.

This is a place where you can get good food in a very nicely decorated restaurant. The service is friendly and the menu is classic. You can brunch there until 4 pm but you should reserve because the wait time without a reservation is usually about one hour. I, for one, think that it is slightly overpriced so I only give 4 stars to this place.

We have been going to Jams every time we visit NYC for several years now.  This might be our last visit. After my partner ordered the food, I asked the waitress what was in the green juice. She had such a weird response. She asked if I was asking her the question.  So strange.  When we wanted to order dessert, our waitress was nowhere to be found. Another waiter had to take our order. 

As for the food, we liked "JW Chicken + Fries."  We didn't care for the 'Spring Gnocchi,' roasted carrots and especially disliked the 'Sticky Toffee Pudding,' which felt too dense and had no discernible dates. 

They use to allow you to use the restrooms in the upper floor. I remember the interesting wood like wall treatment inside the elevator.   Now you have to use the ugly industrial restroom by the kitchen.

We stopped by because the interior vibe were green and cute. We were excited to try Jams' food, especially since our server was so excited about the recommendations. I got the fried chicken sandwich which was fine but not stellar. Given the price, my friend and I were disappointed that the food was bland and not very filling

We came here for brunch because we're staying at the 1hotel. The host acted like she did not want us there. We were first told to wait at the stools while our table was being cleaned. That took about 10 min. We were finally seated and ordered. The coffee came first but they were iced instead of hot (the waitress never asked). We then waited for another 30 min for our food to come out. We started eating some fruit from the market because we were very hungry and were told they didn't not allow outside food. 

The food was okay. 

Unless you have a lot of time to spare for overpriced food, I would not recommend this place. Walk across the street to the supermarket and you may get better food/drinks/service.

I love Jams and every time I eat there I wonder why I do visit more often. The roasted chicken with salsa verde is iconic. If I could I would eat the kale salad everyday. Great service. Beautiful room.
being that the hotel is so expensive you'd think they'd do a better job accommodating guests, hostess is rude and cold food is subpar.

Do this place was a bit of a crapshoot. The options were decretándolos I had the fish tacos and they were amazing. The tortillas with guacamole were actually pretty good! I used the guacamole on my tacos!
Carlyle was a 10/10 bartender! He was so kind and attentive & my anniversary the most memorable night. Also- plz let him ad lib cocktails - they are
Wonderful atmosphere. Perfect for an afternoon drink next to Central Park!! Highly recommend.

This place is located next to Central Park and it was very nicely decorated with many plants inside. 
The waiter was super nice and food was all good.

Beautiful spot nice atmosphere , tasty and fresh food, courteous servers the fish dish was well  as the kale salad presented and delicious. Definitely a place to visit to eat or a night out to sleep .nice hotel  .

Food was fine but service not what I was expecting.  Lattes delivered with a decent bit of them on the saucers, followed by some paper napkins and a shrug.  A portion of my child's breakfast wasn't delivered and once other food was dropped, never saw another member of the waitstaff again.  I had to go and track one down for a water refill and the bill.  Not exceptionally busy on a Sunday so not quite sure what the problem was.  Unlikely to visit again.

Beautiful Sunday afternoon outing by 5th Ave NYC. and shhhhh some shopping. We ended up again at our one of our go-to NYC day dining spots. For us, Jam always is on point. I "L-O-V-E" their brunch burger!! It's so moist and delicious. Did I say delicious?? Their chicken was also very tasty with great seasoning.  Can't say enough about this place and their amazing staff. Definitely recommend.

"Named "Best Chef in New York City" by the James Beard Foundation, Chef Jonathan Waxman brings his seasonal cooking to Jams. The open kitchen, exposed brick, reclaimed oak, and greenery-lined patio make the space as dynamic as the food.
Murat and his team were incredibly attentive and friendly. They handled our large group seamlessly. The food and wine were perfect! Can't wait to go back

Such a great spot. Perfect for any occasion - popping in for drinks/brunch, dinner, etc. I hosted an event here last week and had the best time. Food and cocktails are amazing, as is all of the staff. 5/5

Drink= Paloma
Lite fare= Selection of American Hams w/ hush puppies 
Ambiance= 15/10
Customer Service/Bar Service= 20/10

I'll see you soon!

In short, terrible. 

Immediately when we got seated, I saw a BABY COCKROACH crawl on our table past the menu and my utensils. As I squealed and stood up quickly as it was fast approaching my way, the server was pouring our water and smashed the thing with the water jug he was serving with.

Ugh - whatever, didn't make too much of fuss, just wanted to eat, and moved to a different table. But after a few bites, we saw ANOTHER baby cockroach at a different (empty) table crawling around.

I'm a New Yorker and have seen many roaches in all shapes and sizes and this was definitely, 100% a baby cockroach. 

Otherwise, we got to our table without a wait on a Sunday brunch, and were delighted by the vibe and decor but expected from a 1 Hotel. Food itself was fine - not great but not bad.

To the staff: please look into any infestation problem at this establishment. It's unsanitary.

Terrible overpriced buffet brunch. Not worth it. Food was cold and did not taste good. Don't go. We would have been better off getting a bodega egg sandwich. 

Coffee was good though.

Great space... but, the prices are far too high for what they offer - i.e. a sad little blt and a bag of chips for $21. They also didn't give us an itemized bill, which after asking for it, turns out they had added gratuity, which was NOT noted in the other bill they tried to pass off on us. There are better places in midtown.

Looked lovely so we took a chance. We were seated immediately and told someone would come to take our beverage order. He came immediately and when I asked for a wine list was given a dirty look. List was produced but he basically just dropped it on the table and walked away. We waited 19 minutes, he never came back. Someone went to find and told us they couldn't find him. We decided to leave and explained to the front of the house why. All we got was "Sorry". Went fine the block to Rue 57 and had a fabulous and fun meal there. Head there instead is our best advice!

I honestly feel like the waitstaff here is so rude and miserable and I am sure it's due to poor management. They got the order of my guest wrong and she asked if they would be able to give her the correct order and he said "what do you want me to do about it". Such a cute place with so
Much potential but such sad miserable staff :( such a shame

This is a great location for lunch or brunch, within walking distance to Central Park. This is an Organic Health Aware-style restaurant. I will admit my son said the chicken was too blent, unspiced & too overpriced for its taste. I thought it was a HUGE piece of organic chicken, literally half of it ... He had a "JW Chicken + Fries" ($34.00) &  I had a "Point Judith Crispy Calamari" ($20.00). I thought my Calamaries were fantastically cooked & nicely spiced. Not overpriced for the size either. I think this is a great lunch meeting place with a nice Organic food for a small group. Modern simple organic design decor.

Stopped by jams recently for brunch. The location is great- right next to Central Park so it is a good location if you are planning to spend the day at the park. The ambience is simply lovely. The service was fine too. 

The only thing lacking is the food- it's okay...just not something to write home about. In a city of amazing brunches this place fails to differentiate itself. We had the huevos rancheros, French toast and a side of potatoes. I also ordered the latte. The potatoes were very good. The French toast was slightly better than the huevos rancheros. Huevos rancheros is normally our go-to dish for brunch but the version at jams is really lacking in flavor. The latte was okay, not really the best coffee. There is absolutely no wow factor to the food which is what I was hoping for. I really hope they work on improving the menu since it is a beautiful space that I would love to come back to.
very underwhelmed. food was disappointing and service was awful. took 20 minutes to get ahold of a server, food came out 40 minutes late and cold. looks inviting, but would not recommend

Great little spot. Love all the plants everywhere. We were visiting and literally yelp breakfast spot near me. Good food- we had brunch both were super good. Service was great. We walked in thinking would be a long wait but they got us right in!

The waitstaff was incredibly slow and inattentive. Throughout the course of an hour+ brunch I think I saw my waiter three times and had to repeatedly ask them to take our order or for the check. Afterwards, we were told that since we were a group of six that the minimum gratuity was 20%, absolutely ridiculous for the service we received. The food was just average and the place was cute but for the price and service it's not worth it.

had such an amazing brunch here! food was great, ambiance was so nice. the pancakes are INCREDIBLE! thank you to Murat and the staff for the hospitality! can't wait to go back. 

-Valentina
Best restaurant. Amazing food. Amazing vibe. Highly recommend. They have amazing vegetarian options

Visited Jams for the "Supper that Sustains Us" event and was blown away! Murat Erbil, Olivia, and team provided OUTSTANDING hospitality, and the food quality and taste was absolutely wonderful. Standouts were the squash salad, kale salad, and chicken, among many other tasty dishes. The kale salad dressing was so outstanding that I want to bottle it and take it home! Crisp and refreshing cocktails - loved the Greenhouse. Buzzy ambiance without being too loud or overbearing and great location as well. Ideal spot for a Central Park date or dinner / brunch with friends.
Great food, very well done drinks. Service was bit slow but it was also Friday night & busy. We ate at the bar so we had a cool view.

Just went for my first time for dinner, I was blown away. The food was amazing, the drinks were really good, but the service was beyond the best part of it all. I felt so taken care of and really enjoyed my time there. I'll definitely be going back!!
Delicious food and great atmosphere. Breakfast was just right before a day in the city.

Got in without a reservation. Our waitress Kiri was awesome and super friendly. We got the burger and the fish tacos and they were delicious. Honestly my favorite part was the cocktail. I ordered the drink from the grounds. Literally one of the best cocktails I've ever had.

It's a nice atmosphere, however the service was horrible and slow, and one singular piece of French toast (brioche French toast), which is pictured with three pieces on yelp, is only one single piece of bread, and is $24. A rip off.

One of worst experiences I have had dining. Server never introduced herself, only said about three words, she wasn't rude though, she just interacted with us two times through the whole experience. We had to ask for the bill ourselves, and we were never asked how the food was. Seems as though she expected a tip, that never came because only three words were said to us. I have had fine dining experiences, and for this price and isolating service, this place is nowhere near a fine dining experience. It's the Walmart version of fine dining.

Food was decent. They wouldn't serve us breakfast at 10:40 AM. Booth was dirty with crumbs. Waiter wasn't the most welcoming and seemed a little inconvenienced by everything. They don't have any normal soda brands like sprite coke or Diet Coke, only their own kind. Asked for my fries lightly cooked and they came out extremely crispy and overcooked.

Went on a bleak and rainy Friday night but this place totally lifted your spirits.  The air had a nice scent from a diffuser and plants all around gave this place some good vibes. We had a cozy seat by the big windows.  The waitress couldn't have been nicer and they have a good selection of unique cocktails.  I had the chicken which was okay but want to go back for that gnocchi which seems to be popular.  It's in a great location in midtown and a perfect place to get together with friends.  Menu seems to have a good variety to select from so I need to go back and try more things for sure.

I took 2 lovely visiting cousins from Florida for a leisurely brunch and they just loved Jams!  Emda was our waiter,  Very responsive, very polite, took our photos.  I watched Jams and the hotel being built and it's great to support such an inviting, charming and welcoming restaurant and staff.

Checked out this place yesterday for brunch/lunch and it was jam-packed! I thought of making a reservation but didn't think it would be necessary. Turned out I was wrong. Always make a reservation here, especially on the weekends. 

We were seated by the bar which took awhile for the staff to notice and hand us the menu. I wasn't sure what to expect but was interested in the few options - saw other customers with their French toast -- looks yummy! 

I ended up ordering avocado toast with a side of breakfast sausages and a glass of fresh green juice while my husband got Jams Benedict and a glass of Prosecco. 

Really LOVED my meals. For a restaurant tucked in in a hotel, I was underwhelmed with the presentation but the flavors really triumphed all. I enjoyed every bit of it, especially the breakfast sausage. Even wondered where they got the sausages from... or were they made in house? They were so good! 

The only reason I couldn't give it 5 stars purely for the slow service. It took forever for them to take notice of new customers and then forget to bring us a check and take our card. We'd still want to come back but maybe not on the weekends and will make sure to make a reservation first.

Wen't to Jams for dinner on a Saturday for a friends birthday & we enjoyed it.

We love the greenery covered interior design as well as the beautiful patio. The place is spacious for large gathering. Its open & cosy at the same time.

Food was fresh & locally source. I tasted both the chicken & fish main course & both were good. The salad appetizer came in good portion & equally tasty. I got no sweet tooth but my table mates all enjoyed their dessert.

Our waitress was attentive & we don't feel rushed to leave right away after we were done. We had reservation, and they allowed us to proceed to our seats before all parties arrived, which we appreciate. 

The price was on the higher end of the spectrum but worth it for the service & the food. Would come back for special occassions.

My boyfriend and I am staying at the 1 hotel. We were starving when we landed from LA and was so happy to see such a cute pretty restaurant just downstairs. We went downstairs at 9:25pm and was IGNORED by at least 3 waiters there. When we finally flagged a passing waiter who was trying to avert this eyes, he reluctantly told us he'd have to check w the manager to see if they were still serving dinner. He then came back and said they were. However, when he spoke w his manager, she came back and said they were not serving any food, only drinks at the bar. She was incredibly rude, unhelpful and unprofessional. We were then told by another employee that the restaurant should serve food until at least 9:45pm. We were very evidently there well before 9:45pm. The service we received at this restaurant was incredibly disappointing, which is a huge understatement. I don't even like to post bad Yelp reviews but tonight's service was appalling.

Okay, do Jams is a Johnathan Waxman restaurant so you expect good quality. My wife and I start here each day of our 6 day visit in Manhattan.  Quite frankly, we drank more than we ate but the food we had was fabulous.  Basically small bites and appetizers- guacamole was fresh charcuterie board is huge.  Most importantly the bartenders are friendly and will offer up a tasting of new drinks    Good stop considering it's a block off Central Park

Looked forward to this restaurant visit and was less than impressed. I completely understand the need for patience when dining out, but the service was decidedly slow. Once we did get our food, it was dry and a little warm appearing as though it had sat for a few minutes. The brioche bun used on the breakfast sandwich was so dry and the sauce used was bland at best. The sandwich was nearly $30 and left so much more to be desired. Restaurant is extremely overrated. Better off hitting one of the many mom and pop delis for a bagel w/cream cheese.

Horrible breakfast service. Was hosting a client and we could not get our waitress to be attentive. She couldn't give us water or coffee unless we repeatedly asked for it. Breakfast food was very good but for $24 a plate the service was not there

Brunch was good, not the most exciting menu but still worth it. The vibe is excellent, like a coffee shop vibe but inside a swanky hotel. Being near Central Park is obviously a great perk, eat a good meal more than go for a walk. Sunday brunch is on till 4pm! Oh, and they don't have syrups (weird) so if you get an iced cap, don't ask for vanilla!

Part of my recent NYC visit I stayed at 1 hotel and Jams was the restaurant at the property.
My hotel was really close to Sarabeth's but decided to try out Jams because of convenience and good reviews on Google . To be honest, I left really perplexed. I think I set my expectations too high and then when I got my food ..it didn't meet what I had imagined. I think this place is doable if you want to  hang out with your friends for coffee and maybe get some pastries. 

Food : 3/5
Mushrooms Frittata 3/5 - looked like a flat pancake. Was lacking some moisture almost as if over cooked. Missing seasoning ..had to add salt . Was expecting more and left flat . Not recommended.

Kale salad 3/5 - take a look at pictures.. shredded up kale and some parmesan + dressing. It was savory and to the point. Nothing exciting but delivers pure kale . Not recommended.

Fruit cup 3/5 - take a look at the pic. It's a small mix of fruit cut up in a glass cup. Everything tasted fresh, not more to say here.

Crumble muffins: 3/5 - I'm not sure if they make these in-house or get them from other places, but it's above average pastry and inline with what I would expect for New York..nothing special.

Interior: 5/5
Probably the best part about this restaurant is the interior. If you wanted to just pick up some coffee and maybe a pastry, this is the perfect place to go.

I really love the vibe of this place. The interior is mindful about sustainability, the use of authentic materials and integrates a lot of plants and greenery. It has a very warm and cozy feel.

Lovely decor -- very green, calming and airy brunch cafe. Ideal for a work lunch or to do work alone, enjoying some coffee or tea!

The chicken is tender and flavorful , foccaccia with whipped butter was a fav. Food was nothing toooo memorable but I loved the experience. Servers were accommodating and kind. Great spot near Central Park!

ZERO stars. THE WORST service we've experienced in the city. Had a reservation, we were on time, sat in the back. No problem. Watched a waiter prance around doing nothing except being impressed with himself while a 6 top sat patiently but visibly annoyed and ready to order. He literally walked by them 5 or 6 times and looked at them. He also looked at us several times but never bothered to say hello, or welcome us. After 20 minutes of waiting for WATER, he came to the table next to us and poured water for one gentleman who sat down about 10 minutes AFTER US. He tried to wink at me and tell me he'd be right with us. We got up and left, complained to the gal at the front and she didn't seem concerned. I saw the server smiling at me. So glad we didn't spend a dime at this place.
Excellent, fresh food with good service. Nice space and ambiance, and centrally located.

Jams is one of my favorite restaurants in the city, whether it be for brunch or dinner! Service is always top notch and servers are very knowledgeable. You MUST try the gnocchi, the warm gem salad, and the cauliflower. Drinks are delicious and they have a great wine selection. The hosts always get me accommodated even when I don't have a reservation, They have a DJ on weekends that spin vinyl records, great date night spot!

Traveling on biz and came here for my second day in a row. 

I am going to add this place to my list of nycs
"to do"  for breakfast...  staff at the bar rocks! They're a great team. 

Food is ahhhb-maaaazzzzing and the mimosas rock that perfect color with only a hint of orange. I had the avocado toast day one and the eggs Benny day two. Both fantastic. 10 for 10 will come again

Man, what a disappointment. Atmosphere is super cozy and cool, but the music was obnoxiously loud and made it difficult to carry on a conversation at all.  But we came for food and reviews were promising. I don't understand all the rave reviews because the food was meh at best. Under seasoned, over cooked, just super disappointing. Lamb chops were over well, and the gnocchi was "seared" until it dried up like cardboard. No amount of sauce could rescue either. Maybe brunch is better? The side of Parmesan potatoes were okay but still needed the aid of sauce. The staff were all very friendly, which is the only reason I'd give it another chance. I could see it as a cool spot for drinks, but I don't think I would eat here again.
Went had dinner with the wife. The food was amazing, the ambience was so greaT as well. The service really stood out always paying attention to our needs. Cant wait to go back.

Fantastic staff, delicious cocktails and good quality dishes. My personal favorites the Jams Kale salad and the Hudson Valley trout!!
Walking distance to Central Park for a nice walk after food. 10/10

Yum!  

Located at the base of a cute boutique hotel I believe is called "1" - Jams is cute and has a neat vibe going on with some lovely outdoor patio seating with great people-watching. 

Nice menu with a pretty balanced amount of items to please most palettes.  I ordered the warm coffee muffin as a starter, a coffee, and the yogurt parfait with fresh berries.  

I didn't see any photos of the parfait on yelp so I wasn't able to "try before buying" like I usually do - but I guessed it would be OK and it was.  Fresh delicious blackberries, strawberries and blueberries with a decent portion of granola and yogurt.  The granola was fresh and crunchy and the yogurt had a buttery coconut flavor to it.  I had some fresh honey on the side to drizzle on top and it was heaven!  Really good.  Smaller portion though for $14 so it's tough to make that a meal on its own. 

My husband ordered the breakfast sandwich which was a brioche bun with eggs (he did egg whites), fried ham, cheese and greens.  Really good and the bun was delicious! 

Their coffee was great and the inside/outside areas are beautiful with greenery everywhere and updated cups and nice tables.  

Our waiter was great and we had a nice experience here with a nice pace for the service and food.

Jams is awesome! The food is delicious (best huevos rancheros I've ever had) and the cocktails are sublime! Best yet, the service is genuinely some of the best in the city. Emda and Murat were both so nice and helpful!

Great space, decent food but I left asking a question about having a private party only to be given a short and rather rude response from what appears to be the manager (yeah you with the facial hair!).

I'm sorry- even if you don't know the question to something I think at least a humanely nice response vs a short, sour and rather rude response would be appreciated especially after we just ate there.

Thanks but no thanks.... you ruined the experience. ‍‍

loved the food, drinks and ambiance. amazing service as well! had a bit of everything and favorite dish was probably the scallops. Great, great lunch. Server was very attentive and management team was constantly present. Overall great experience.

Jams is one of the best restaurants in New York. Easy, friendly ambiance. Nice amount of space between tables. Excellent staff delicious food. Our favorite dishes were the beet and fennel salad, chicken and absolutely favorite: Delicious trout with sorrel sauce.
Nice restaurant and good location. Food was good but a little pricey. Wait staff was excellent!
Hahah... food is ok! Service is hilarious. I arrived 17minutes after my party. Server saw me and still came 14 minutes later. Couldn't get the drink order correct. Manager/ hostess saved the day.
The service is TRASH. They're so rude. Its really unfortunate because the food is absolutely delicious.
Hard to screw up breakfast but they managed. Cold and rubbery eggs Benedict. Avocado toast on brick hard bread. Space is nice and service was fine.  Food was embarrassingly bad.

Went to brunch yesterday and everything was delightful! I was most impressed with their kale salad, that's not something I'd usually order but it was soooooo good. I also had the jams Benedict and French toast. Waitress was very nice to use, ambiance was very everything and I am looking forward to going back.
All the dishes are so fresh and the portions are perfect. You leave feeling almost healthier I would say.

Ducked in her during a rain storm for some coffee and a lite lunch.  Ambiance is open, airy, garden like, with outside seating option.Very, Very loud.  Food, coffee, drinks were good!   Service was S L O W.  Took a bit to be acknowledged once we sat down, food came fast!  And then again S L O W- it took way too long to get our server to bring the check....literally could not make eye contact with him when he moved in and out...so my husband finally took the credit card to him.  And now as I wrote this post...the sad lil card is sitting in front of me waiting to pay the bill...waiting...waiting....thankfully we aren't in a hurry.   So, yes, I recommend, just make sure you have time.
I really like this spot. You can never go wrong with a Jonathan Waxman restaurant. Went for brunch. Such clean food. Super tasty. I love the salads here. Very sleek and modern decor, nice service.

We are staying down the street from this restaurant and walked by several times. We decided to go here for a casual anniversary celebration. We had wonderful service by Saydimar and fantastic food and drinks. Nice pour on cocktails and the signature chicken dish is amazing! We would definitely recommend coming here :)

Good brunch vibes here and the restaurant itself is soo pretty and naturey. A lot of greenery everywhere and the healthy options on the menu fit the vibe perfectly. We were able to get seated without a reservation on a Saturday afternoon. 

I would recommend the juices they offer and the avocado toast was good and simple. Not over the top. Good spot to come to but I wouldn't make a trek out to this spot. 

It's also connected to a hotel which makes it very convenient for hotel stayers to get a nice brekkie for the morning.
This is a cool bar with good drinks. The service is good and the apps are good as well.

This place was a lovely surprise! The restaurant is full of greenery and tucked inside a hotel. We stumbled in for a late brunch on a Sunday afternoon and were seated immediately. This was our third place and we were surprised they let us in so easily and were kinda wondering if the food would be good. It was delicious!

I had the avocado toast with poached eggs and a matcha latte. The toast was only one piece of toast and I thought that was odd, but I guess it was to balance out the huge side salad it came with.

The matcha latte was fresh, hot and filling. 

Will return next time in NYC!

Great breakfast at Jams. The eggs Benedict had great hollandaise sauce with just enough lemon to create the perfect level of tartness. I had to order potatoes as I'm not a fan of salad for breakfast. (It should be an option guys.) However it was a breakfast and great service. I'll see you again next time when I visit New York.

We had brunch reservations and were late due to traffic in an Uber.  We missed brunch but they saved our table and we had lunch. The waitstaff was wonderful and the food oh so delicious!!  I can't wait to go back and actually make it for breakfast food.

Great cocktails - check.  Solid food - check.  Fantastic brunch - check.   Great atmosphere - check.  One block off the park - Bonus.  What more are you looking for in a stop-off?  Dig deeper and you can do better but if you are in mid-town and hungry or thirsty - don't be afraid to duck in here.

The food here is nondescript American; it's ok, albeit expensive, but not much more. I had a piece of fish with rice; my friend had the chickpea hamburger. Both were ok, but nothing special.
The problem with this place was the sound level. The restaurant was half empty during out meal, so the sound didn't come from other dinners but from  music playing in the background. Initially the music was loud and barely tolerable. We asked the waitress if it could be turned down, and it was. Shortly afterwards the sound came back twice as loud and deafening. My friend and I were sitting next to each other at a small table and had to shout to carry on a conversation. When I asked to speak to the manager, she arrived, and stood about two feet away as we shouted at the top of our voices in our conversation. The manager said the sound couldn't be turned down because there was another party that wanted upbeat excitement and a DJ was playing the music. Why we weren't told that there would be a DJ and deafening noise during our meal so we'd have the option of eating at Jams or going somewhere else is beyond me. If you want to rock and roll around a restaurant while you eat your overpriced chickpea hamburger, come here. If you want to eat a meal in quiet peace, go elsewhere. I certainly intend to do so. I have no intention of coming back.

Food was ok - , nothing more than that, hostess was not that kind at all, ambiance was great. Price was too high for quality, quantity and flavor. Coffee was $7 and tasted like a gas station coffee. That's not good! Won't coma back

I love this spot! Their food is really fresh and the dining room is gorgeous. It's kinda casual while still elevated dining. The One Hotel is also really nice. You can't go wrong for an after work drink or dinner here.

Jams is a delightful place I frequent with friends after the occasional Broadway show or when I find myself in Midtown.  Came here on a rainy Saturday after the Flamenco Festival at NY City Center.  My friend and I shared the Cheese and Charcuterie Board, their Hummus and the Winter Salad.  They are great portions to share if you aren't overly ravenous and / or watch what you eat and try to eat healthily. 

Our waitress was wonderful, she checked up on us several times and was really friendly and attentive.  

What I probably love most about Jams is the homey, cozy and warm atmosphere - many beautiful, rich green plants adorn the restaurant everywhere, from the entrance to the area in the back and even above the open bar and kitchen area.  

If you're in the Midtown East-ish area or walking by the southern part of Central Park, pop into Jams for brunch or linner!  You won't be disappointed.

The food just isn't good. No flavor. Portions are small. Everything is way over priced. For $55, I expect a good steak. Not a poor quality piece of meat that I can cook at home. I guess you are just paying for the location and the "ambience". This is just fancy cocktail place that serves bad food IMHO.

The ambiance here is so delightful. I've never been to a restaurant filled with the fragrance of frankincense... it was actually wonderful. By coincidence , the soft music was my favorite artist from Cape Verde. The restaurant is attached to a hotel lobby with matching decor. The food was very good, not excellent... for NYC, at least. Great central location for breakfast before work in Manhattan. I'll definitely be back.

Nice atmosphere. Food was not great. Jams Benedict was cold from the eggs to the bread. The little salad had almost zero dressing so just greens. The americano was ok. Definitely not worth the price.  The server was fine but nothing beyond taking the order and getting check. Would not come back.
We had breakfast and lunch and it was delicious. Service was great. Very nice atmosphere. I highly recommend and we will be back!

Picture yourself surrounded by a symphony of vibrant greenery, enveloped in an upscale bar in the heart of Midtown. A bar where your greeted by a bright and airy space adorned with natural elements like wood, stone, and living plants, MANY MANY living plants, WOW!

The menu reflects a commitment to fresh, wholesome ingredients and a strong catering to vegetarians. But more importantly, even in a jungle within the beautiful concrete jungle  of NYC you can still find a good Old Fashioned. Cheers!!
Ambiance is great but the food is not what it should be given the prices. Ive come here a lot since its opened and it repeatedly dissappoints
ahi tuna salad was horrific, had so much potential because the ambiance is so nice. do not come for food. (Also cost $40 for just a salad).

Beautiful location. Managed to slide in for an early dinner right after the holiday. Hostess was charming. Apparently we were either brand loyal or all on the same page because chose three Jam's Fashioned cocktails (with the focaccia!) and three JW Organic Chicken (similar prep to Barbuto) and were in heaven. Flavors were spectacular as expected. Rhubarb Cobbler dessert wasn't as wonderful as I wanted it to be but Harry's Strawberries with pistachio gelato was a hit. Dinner was ~$80 each before tip.

It was a gorgeous Sunday morning, so my husband and I decided to enjoy the outdoors and Central Park so we made a reservation at Jams. As soon as we got in, we were immediately seated. The decor is very apothecary/lots of greenery- definitely a cute vibe. We were serviced immediately and ordered the full brunch and brioche French toast as well as their signature green juice. We got the food fairly quickly. I will say I really enjoyed the potatoes and the green juice as they were spectacular and filled with flavor. I get the hype about their brioche French toast. It comes out and it is a huge slab a French toast, but you are surprisingly shocked with how fluffy the texture is. On top of that when you dip it in the maple syrup, it is filled with flavor. The full breakfast brunch was good, it was nothing spectacular so I wouldn't order again.

I had dinner at Jams and it was a nice  space with plants and chic decor. The chef is Jonathan Waxman. It's in The 1 Hotel Central Park. The appetizers, soup and entrees are fresh and are similar to Farm to Table and New American cuisine. The hotel is Gold LEED Certified. As it's the summer, it was busy, but relaxed. The waitress provided good service and was personable and attentive. Dessert , I ordered the affogato with coffee ice cream and coffee sauce. They have a bar area and tables are laid out well with some banquettes and different arrangements.

The moment you step into Jams, you're greeted by stunning greenery and a warm ambiance that feels like a blend of greenhouse and restaurant. We started with the focaccia and seared scallops, and the scallops were truly outstanding. For my main course, I had the striped bass, which was perfectly cooked. The service was friendly and attentive throughout. Nestled near Central Park, Jams offers an exceptional dining experience, making it the perfect spot to savor expertly crafted cocktails and a memorable dinner.
Great healthy lunch salads! And it's right at the park. Found it here and I recommend it!

The service was very friendly and knowledgeable of the food when we asked what they recommended. The food was pretty decent and the lobster was fresh. The setting is very country chic with all the live plants.

Much to my dismay Jams Reataurant now has a live DJ that plays very loud music in the dining room thus causing a very distressful dining experience. You can't hear conversations with friends or hear yourself think. Just the pounding sounds of music in your eardrums.  
I won't go back for dinner there again unless it's Sunday, Monday or Tuesday   night when there is no DJ to enjoy the food and environment. 
New York City is loud enough.

In love with this place !! The aura is amazing, its fillies with plants, making the place super lively !! Great outdoor seating and outstanding servers. The food is also incredible. Trying the raspberry dessert is a must!!

I got the New York cut Steak, fries, and asparagus. Each item was done to perfection. Oleg was my server, he was attentive and accommodating, fantastic job. I enjoyed my bourbon, and I never had to wait on staff to ask if I needed my drink refilled. Fantastic visit, highly recommend. The atmosphere is pleasant and conversational.

Not accommodating at all staying at hotel no kids menu for breakfast. That's fine but they won't substitute anything and you end up paying $60 for kids eggs, potatoes, and bread. Entire menu then becomes a la carte. Waiters aren't helpful at all and the food is extremely average.

We were celebrating our friend's engagement at Jams and let me tell ya it was amazing. We had such a great time, from the drinks to the food to the music to the ambiance and the service was all top tier. We started off at the bar and ordered a few seasonal cocktails. I had a drink that tasted like an old fashioned but with pumpkin, yummm. I don't normally like pumpkin flavor things but this was good! The chocolate expresso was also really good and the autumn harvest was a smooth sipping pleasure. 
Direct quote, "the Sakura Martini deserves many praises." 

We started off with a few appetizers, the Autumn Flatbread, Maplebrook Burrata, Pan Seared Local Scallops and this amazing Whipped Ricotta Dip. I asked for the scallops to be a lil' crispier and they were literally delicious. So soft in the middle with a light crunch along the edges.

We went with a family style approach and ordered for the table so we could share everything. Starting with the Halibut Florentine, so good. Really flavorful and I enjoyed the Hazelnut Gremolata it was sitting on top of. The Gnocchi was certainly filling and the pesto sauce was super fresh. The short rib risotto was banging! Oh my goodness, it was delicious, probably my favorite. I can't forget to mention the Brussels sprouts, we had to order it twice with the hopes of saving some for the next day. I don't know what we were thinking because we devoured both plates, no leftovers! 

If you weren't already convinced, just try it and you'll thank me later. 


P.S. Thank you to Egypt for the recommendations, we loved them all.

Went here for breakfast over the weekend.
We both ordered the lobster Eggs Benedict, and I got a side of bacon.

The eggs were massively overcooked, and everything was delivered cold -- even the bacon, which looked like it had been cooked the day before.  The muffins were teeny, and not a lot of lobster (though that was anticipated).

I gave this 3 Stars, because although the food was cold and overcooked, the staff was friendly and relatively responsive (the hostess, however, was not in a great hurry to seat anybody).  We loved the decor and lively vibe.

Just wish the food could have been a bit better for the money.

I came here for brunch. I felt the overall word for Jams was "okay." There were four of of us, and we all felt out food was fine but a little overpriced. The service started good but then when we wanted to get the check and leave, we couldn't flag down a waiter for over ten minutes. The decor is pretty.
Great food.  Fun and attentive staff.  Will be going back again today. There is a large bar for people dining single.
Great brunch! Food was very good. Service was good- could have cleared out dirty dishes a little faster. Champagne was great- espresso martinis are a little sweet!  Very glad we had a reservation.

burger is excellent  as well as spinach ricotta pasta excellent 

Chicken salad ok
Ham and cheese sandwich little soggy 

Very charming and chilled atmosphere 

Service good

This place was ok! Came in just because it was close to where I parked, and the atmosphere was nice. Ordered drinks and a pastry, so I don't have much to say about the actual food. We did end up waiting a bit for a table to be ready on a weekday morning, but service was good.

The restaurant itself is really beautiful. Elevated casual. It's busy so make a reservation. Staff is friendly. Margaritas are some of the best I've had in the city and the French fries are good. That's all the good I have to say. 

Unfortunately, I was greatly disappointed with the food, especially because it was Christmas Day! Everything was wayyyyyy too salty and not even slightly seasoned. It was just straight salt. Potatoes were definitely a couple days old (you know that taste leftover potatoes have? It had that). And the most upsetting part of it all? It ended up being $100 per person. 

I would actually return for only the margaritas, but if you choose to eat, be warned it might be the blandest experience ever.
Really relaxed feel but quality food. Nice accessibility to the park. People are friendly!

Jams at 1 Hotel has all the makings of a great brunch spot--beautiful ambiance, a cozy setting, and a menu that feels promising. However, for a higher-end hotel, the food itself is pretty average. 

That said, their menu is quite unique - we opted for the vegan peanut butter oatmeal, botanical breakfast and side of chicken sausage. Truly, their peanut butter chocolate oatmeal is absolutely TO DIE FOR--rich, comforting, and worth a return visit just for that alone. Everything else was decent but nothing particularly standout.

Since table space in NYC is quite limited, we opted to sit at the bar, which ended up being a great choice. The bar has a beautiful counter, and the plus side is that you can order food there as well--a nice perk if you prefer a more relaxed experience.

Service-wise, our experience was mixed. The host was not friendly or accommodating, coming across as standoffish and uninterested. Fortunately, our server was fantastic--attentive, fast, and kind, which made a huge difference.

On a super cold east coast morning, stepping into a warm, inviting space for a cozy brunch was exactly what I needed to fuel up for the workday. While the food overall doesn't necessarily match the upscale setting, the oatmeal alone is enough for me to return.

First of all I LOVED the interior decor in this restaurant. It's gorgeous. There are plants everywhere and lots of attention to detail with decor. That was my favorite part. 

The food was decent but I will say it was a bit too expensive for what was provided and the quality of it. I would give this place another star if it was a bit cheaper. Felt overpriced to me. But the food was good enough. 

As for the service; our waiter was lovely! He was a great listener and attentive to our needs. He brought over a muffin for my friend's birthday and was super kind about it.

I think this is a nice spot to check out. Just be aware that it's a little pricey for what you get.

Love this restaurant for a post Central Park walk because it keeps you in the greenery vibes. 

Food comes out quickly and drinks are great! Even has a small mocktail menu, recommend the green drink. 

Pro Tip! Don't be worries if you don't have a res, just pop in and you can probably sit at the bar

Brunch is definitely summer weather vibes, but seems like we still have a lot of time left! Till then, we can sit in Jams and feel like we are in California by the beach with all these nature decorations to help us cope. 

 I got the lobster Benedict and it was small in size. I definitely ate it in four bites but the hollandaise sauce was done well, with the poached eggs. I love how the lobster wasn't fishy at all and cooked to perfection.

My friends got the fried chicken sandwich, everything bagel with smoked salmon and a yogurt bowl

Gorgeous interior, with soft lighting, warm natural elements, and greenery. We went to the bar for a cocktail and a light nosh. The drinks were good and very generous. The wait staff was super accommodating and friendly. The food was fresh and delicious. I would def come here again and so should you!

This place is a must visit! The ambiance is trendy, warm and inviting. The service is friendly and attentive. And the food is so fresh, flavorful and unique! They have something to offer for everyone!

Some things were good and others a total flop.  The focaccia was not worth it.  We also got the gnocchi as an appetizer which was super salty, not a lot of meat- it was ok.  The halibut was terrible.  Super small portion and the sauce was salty.  The bison burger was good, nothing special.  The organic chicken was the star of the night.  The date cake was bad, but the homemade cookies were very good.  Overall for $300 it was just ok.
